frozen_claims.primary: Under the frozen common aerodynamic reference-state protocol, icing is associated with a positive empirical total-battery electrical-power penalty. The identification analysis estimated Delta P_batt,ref = 35.46 W (20.88%; pair-jackknife SE 3.55 W; one-sided p=3.691E-7). Under the prospectively locked validation protocol, the positive effect was independently confirmed with Delta P_batt,ref = 31.37 W (18.57%; pair-jackknife SE 4.72 W; one-sided p=4.726E-5). Identification and validation effects are reported separately and are not pooled.
frozen_claims.conservative: Across the identification and prospectively locked validation analyses, icing produced a reproducible positive increase in empirical total battery electrical power at the frozen common aerodynamic reference state. The identification estimate was 35.46 W (20.88%), while the independent validation estimate was 31.37 W (18.57%). No equality or pooling of the two effect magnitudes is claimed.
